wifi.eapStart: {{client}} starts 802.1X (EAP) for “{{ssid}}” at {{ap}} – user “{{user}}”, sending RADIUS Access-Request.
wifi.eapSuccess: 802.1X: {{client}} (“{{user}}”) accepted for “{{ssid}}” by the RADIUS server (Access-Accept).
